name: Bird feeder camera with on-device classification
description: A camera at a feeder that decides on-device whether a frame contains a bird before spending power on the radio. Requires an accelerator, not just a camera — running classification on the host is the version that flattens a battery in a day.

requires.note: upload only the frames worth uploading
buffer when the link is down
Lives outdoors year-round. ASA rather than PLA because the part sits in direct sun, and PLA creeps above roughly 60 C. The 1.2 mm floor is the lens shroud lip.

related_designs: ClawCam — node firmware, gateway and detection pipeline for exactly this shape of build
